title: A goal research story records a sibling item's defect as a finding instead of landing its fix
goal: The research story's brief names each sibling item of the sprint with its goal and touches, and says a defect a sibling carries is reported as a finding in the research's notes, not fixed in the research commit. In SP-lsamtvsz the research ST-e62uklfi (touches kb/public/**) renamed Localization to FluentLocalization in the four files BG-nzrj2n32 owned, so the bug's worker had only its repro's negation mentions left and the sibling's planned check no longer read the work.

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys
R = os.getcwd()
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
def sh(*a):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True)
sh('git', 'init', '-q', '.')
sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', 'commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T)
os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh('python3', R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
r = bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'a goal')
sid = re.search(r'SP-\w+', r.stdout).group(0)
rs = re.search(r'research story (ST-\w+)', r.stdout).group(1)
r = bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Sibling story', '--sprint', sid, '--goal', 'SIBGOALTEXT renames nothing', '--touch', 'kb/public/sibtouch.md')
if r.returncode:
    print(r.stderr); sys.exit(2)
out = bl('brief', rs).stdout
has = 'SIBGOALTEXT' in out and 'kb/public/sibtouch.md' in out
rule = any(re.search('sibling', ln, re.I) and re.search('finding', ln, re.I) for ln in out.splitlines())
print('sibling goal+touches in the research brief:', has, '| sibling-defect-is-a-finding rule line:', rule)
sys.exit(0 if has and rule else 1)

notes: SP-lsamtvsz retrospective finding (2026-10-14), parked as a draft by the orchestrating session acting for the operator.
